assistant.languages.anyNote: Covers the 10 core languages. Pick others under “These languages” or as the main language.
assistant.languages.help: {named, select, yes {{name} greets} other {The assistant greets}} and speaks in the main language; the greeting, goodbye and other fixed lines are said in it (a greeting that is still the default changes with it). When a caller speaks another language you allow, it answers in that language from then on; otherwise it goes on in the main language. Without a main language of its own it follows the workspace language (Workspace settings › General). Summaries and messages for the team are in the workspace language, transcripts stay in the language spoken. Every voice speaks every language listed; Voice suggests ones native in it. Same price per minute; the first reply after a switch can take a moment longer.
